newsitem.title: LEBANON: Italian PM Prodi arrives in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Italian PM Prodi arrives in Beirut.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi arrived in Beirut on Tuesday for talks with Lebanese leaders on the stalled Middle East peace talks and bilateral economic cooperation.

Fulvio Rustico, Italy's commercial councillor in Beirut, was quoted by Beirut newspapers on Tuesday as saying that Prodi would discuss with Lebanese leaders the issue of the stalled peace talks between Lebanon, Syria and Israel.
Prodi is due to meet President Elias Hrawi, Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri and Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri before leaving Beirut later in the day.
He arrived at Beirut airport from the Syrian capital Damascus at the head of a trade delegation representing major Italian companies.
In February, Prodi told Hariri in Rome that Italy remained committed to Lebanon's reconstruction from the 1975-90 civil war.
Italy is Lebanon's biggest trading partner and is one of the biggest financial contributors to the rebuilding effort. Major Italian firms are involved in the reconstruction work.
